title: Clinical Scope of Virtual Care Encounters and Use of Referral Units
content:
What a Virtual Care encounter may produce depends on its visit type: prescriptions renewed, labs ordered, referrals ordered and work or school notes issued each only where the visit type's scope setting allows it.

## Rule

1. **Prescriptions.** Prescriptions are renewed only where the visit type's prescription renewal setting is Yes, and never a controlled prescription unless the visit type's controlled prescribing setting is Yes.
2. **Labs.** Labs are ordered where the visit type's lab order setting is Yes.
3. **Referrals ordered.** Referrals are ordered where the visit type's referral order setting is Yes.
4. **Work or school notes.** Work or school notes are issued where the visit type's work or school note setting is Yes.
5. **Referral units.** A Specialty Video Follow-Up booked against a referral uses one unit of it on completion only where that referral's tier counts telehealth against units; the Referrals & Prior Authorizations rules decide.
6. **Recording.** Sessions are never recorded; the recording setting is No on every visit type.

## Prescription renewal read on its two settings

| Prescription renewal setting | Controlled prescribing setting | Non-controlled prescription renewed from the encounter | Controlled prescription renewed from the encounter |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Permitted by this rule | Not barred by this rule |
| Yes | No | Permitted by this rule | Never |
| No | Yes or No | Not renewed | Not renewed |

## Referral units

A Specialty Video Follow-Up booked against a referral held under Referrals & Prior Authorizations uses one unit of that referral on completion only where the referral's tier counts telehealth against units. Whether it does is decided by the Referrals & Prior Authorizations rules, not by Virtual Care. A unit is used on completion; a Specialty Video Follow-Up that has not been completed uses no unit under this clause.

## Points of reference

**May a referral be ordered from any Virtual Care encounter?** Only from a visit type whose referral order setting is Yes.

**May a Virtual Care session be recorded at the patient's request?** No. Sessions are never recorded.
